title: Implement Softmax
hint: softmax(x)_i = exp(x_i) / sum(exp(x_j)). Subtract max(x) first for numerical stability.

description.text: Implement softmax along a dimension: softmax(x_i) = exp(x_i) / sum_j exp(x_j). Subtract the max along dim before exp for numerical stability.

examples.explanation: Each entry is proportional to exp(x_i) after stabilizing by subtracting max(x).

constraints: Normalize along the given dim so probabilities sum to 1 on that dim.
Must be numerically stable (avoid exp of large positive values).
Do not use torch.softmax, F.softmax, or nn.Softmax.
